'''Margot Llobera Farré''' (born 18 May 1996) is an Andorran rally raid motorcycle rider and retired [[women's association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Defender (association football)|defender]]. She was a member of the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra women's national team]].<ref>{{cite news|publisher=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]|title=Margot Llobera renueva su sueño por el Dakar|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/abci-margot-llobera-dakar-202104110155_noticia.html|language=fr|date=11 April 2021}}</ref> She also participated as a [[Motorcycle|motorbiker]] in the [[2019 FIM Bajas World Cup]] at the [[Baja Aragón]] and as a [[Side-by-side (vehicle)|side-by-side]] [[co-driver]] at the [[2022 Dakar Rally]].

She is the niece of paraplegic rally driver and former alpine skier [[Albert Llovera]]. Her sister Alexia also participated in the Dakar Rally.<ref>{{cite news|publisher=[[Mundo Deportivo]]|title=Las hermanas Dakar|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/motor/rally-dakar/20180130/44400435013/hermanas-dakar-llobera.html|language=es|date=9 February 2018}}</ref>
